en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned town square with historic multi‑story buildings bearing German signage. In the center-right stands an ornate stone fountain or monument with statues. Shop signs advertise goods such as colonial wares, cigars, wine, spirits, delicacies, and confectionery. A few children and a horse‑drawn carriage are visible, suggesting an early 20th‑century European scene.
